task.title: Research plan/run/consult/backtest cards
task.summary_zh: 依 SD §11.2 做策略工坊的 ResearchPlanCard/ResearchRunCard/ConsultResultCard/BacktestResultCard,資料來自 AG-BE-RS-002 投影與 §7.4 backtest comparison 欄位;走 BFF client research.ts(live strict,禁止頁面直接 fetch)。 【有疑問一定要提出,不要自己亂做】動工前先讀完引用的設計稿(SD 對應章節 + docs/04/pantheon_agora_cross_repo_2026-06-20/design-closure/ + canonical services/control-plane/specs/agora/*.schema.json / openapi/agora_v1.openapi.yaml / capability_manifest.json)。只要遇到任何疑問、不確定、設計稿沒寫到、與既有 code 對不上、依賴不清、無法重現或衝突,一律 STOP,用 blocker(或向 reviewer handoff)把問題具體寫出來並等待澄清,絕對不可自行臆測、補洞、繞過或先做再說。可動工的部分必須與引用 spec/schema 逐欄位一致:不得自創 schema/欄位/評分/widget/route、不得擴張 capability allowlist、不得讓 Agora 直接下單/綁資金/寫 RuntimeBinding。 【UI 一律照設計稿,不要自己發想】凡與畫面有關(頁面、route、layout、component、widget、chart、互動、文案、樣式)必須嚴格依 SD §9/§10/§11/§12/§23 的 IA/版面/元件規格、design-closure A3 widget_registry/chart grammar,以及 V10/V11 視覺參考實作;沿用既有 design tokens 與共用元件,不得自創畫面、元件、版面、route 或自由發揮樣式。設計稿沒涵蓋到的畫面或互動,先開 blocker 問清楚再做。
acceptance: 四種研究卡由 BFF 投影驅動且欄位對齊 §7.3/§7.4;live strict 無 fallback;附 UI 測試;【驗收】實作與引用 spec/schema 逐欄位一致,無自創欄位/route/enum;遇疑問須先開 blocker 澄清而非自行實作;自行臆測或偏離設計稿一律不通過

handoffs.message: Anchor commit 03f7e904. Delivered: ResearchRunCard.tsx (research_progress), BacktestResultCard.tsx (research_result), research.ts BFF client. All 43 new tests pass. Components field-for-field aligned with v4 workshop_card.schema.json. Backend mode always visibly labeled per B6/B10. WorkshopCardRenderer wiring NOT included (standalone-only per task scope). Reviewer: please verify v4 schema alignment and B6/B10 compliance.

Reviewer reopened: research.ts mutating methods omit required X-Request-Id from agora_v1_3 OpenAPI (create/approve/cancel/dispatch/cancel-run), and ResearchCommandResponse invents ok/request_id/idempotency_key instead of CommandResponse status/data/meta. Focused tests, build:agora, and contract:drift passed; full npm test still has unrelated existing management/BFF failures. Please fix and hand back.

Fixed both reviewer issues: (1) ResearchCommandResponse replaced with CommandResponse {status,data,meta} matching agora_v1_3 OpenAPI schema; (2) X-Request-Id header (requestId option) added to all 5 mutating methods (create/approve/cancel/dispatch/cancel-run). Added 22 focused tests. Verified: vitest 22/22, build:agora clean, contract:drift pass. Commit: daa2b971

Changes requested: ResearchRunCard and BacktestResultCard are added/tested but never wired into WorkshopCardRenderer; research_progress/research_result still render old inline ResearchProgressCard/ResearchResultCard, so actual workshop UI does not use the delivered cards. Please import/wire the new components in WorkshopCardRenderer and add renderer-level tests proving research_progress -> ResearchRunCard and research_result -> BacktestResultCard. Reviewer validation run: npm test -- ResearchRunCard.test.tsx BacktestResultCard.test.tsx research.test.ts (65 passed); npm run build:agora (passed); npm run contract:drift (passed).

Reviewer changes addressed: WorkshopCardRenderer now routes research_progress -> ResearchRunCard and research_result -> BacktestResultCard (removed inline duplicates). Added WorkshopCardRenderer.test.tsx with 5 renderer-level wiring tests. All 48 tests pass, build:agora passed, contract:drift passed. Commit 92cb60f4.
Codex review approved; owner Claude to finalize, open PR, refresh branch against origin/dev, and merge before done.
